query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('binding',to_jsonb(b),'starts_at',GREATEST(b.adopted_at,m.consent_at)) AS "data!" FROM whatsapp_group_binding b JOIN whatsapp_group_membership m ON m.binding_id=b.id WHERE m.account_id=$1 AND m.authorization_generation=$2 AND m.consent_ended_at IS NULL AND b.state='active' AND whatsapp_linked_can_view(b.channel_id,$3) ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 100
